title.value: Pandemic policy assessment by artificial intelligence
title.justification: The title succinctly reflects the primary focus of the paper, which is the evaluation and analysis of pandemic control policies using artificial intelligence techniques.
title.quote: Pandemic policy assessment by artificial intelligence

extractions.description: This paper presents a system employing AI to evaluate pandemic mobility-control policies. The system includes a simulation framework, a reinforcement-learning oracle, and policy assessment protocols to analyze policies like city lockdown, community quarantine, and route management. It focuses on execution complexity, effectiveness, costs, benefits, and risks, intending to support governmental decision-making during pandemics.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on evaluating pandemic policies using AI, which does not directly relate to any pre-defined eco-responsible categories. It primarily addresses public health policy assessment, not environmental issues or climate change.
primary_category.quote: Here, we develop a pandemic policy assessment system that employs artificial intelligence (AI) to evaluate and analyze mobility-control policies.

secondary_categories.quote: The proposed system includes three components: a general simulation framework, an AI oracle, and policy assessment protocols.
